_comment: Curated publish titles (YouTube title + thumbnail header) per course, keyed by course id. Search-first: what someone would actually type. Each course adds its own when it is authored.
start: What is a database? PostgreSQL and psql for beginners
design: Database design for beginners: entities, keys, normalisation, double-entry
build: SQL CREATE TABLE, primary keys, foreign keys and constraints (PostgreSQL)
query: SQL SELECT, WHERE, NULL and CASE: query one table (PostgreSQL)
combine: SQL JOINs explained: INNER, LEFT, self-joins, subqueries, EXISTS and UNION
analyse: SQL window functions and CTEs: RANK, LAG, running totals, recursive queries
change: SQL UPDATE, DELETE, INSERT SELECT and MERGE: changing data safely
concurrency: SQL transactions, MVCC, isolation levels, locks and deadlocks (PostgreSQL)
perform: SQL performance: EXPLAIN ANALYZE, B-tree, composite and covering indexes
secure: PostgreSQL security: roles, least privilege, row-level security, SQL injection
